novelty_claim: Replace the aligned-LLM mutation stage with a fixed, diverse library of semantic wrapper templates and a lightweight internal judge, eliminating the dependency on a non-refusing mutator and extending coverage to the full Forge victim panel.
initial_hypothesis: At <=12 target calls per goal, the static-template library will achieve a mean ASR greater than 0 on the AdvBench-50 panel, beating the locked baseline mean ASR of 0.0 and fixing the model-block and mutator-collapse failures.
key_insight: Modern aligned mutators refuse to author attack templates, so TurboFuzzLLM's LLM-driven mutations collapse into benign filler; a compact set of general semantic framings (persona, fiction, code, crisis, educational) covers distinct refusal failure modes without per-goal branching.
